title: Lumas new creative agents are a huge leap forward in AI creative production #freeonlinetools #ai
description:
Lumas new creative agents are a huge leap forward in AI creative production Instead of creating individual assets the platform orchestrates several subagents to perform individual tasks simultaneously choosing the best model for the taskathand It blew my mind in early testing My motherinlaw wanted to create a YouTube video explaining simple stock trading techniques to young adults using cartoon characters that each represented a candlestick pattern I explained to her that the process would require hundreds of individual image generations for each character followed by imagetovideo variations for each VO SFX and music would be required as well before stitching it all together That process would have taken hours and hours across several different programs and models But Luma nailed it in one take from a simple prompt 15 mins later we had a 10 minute Youtube video that looked and sounded great with perfect accuracy across all candlestick patterns Now you can see why I think multiagent orchestration is the future of creative production LumaPartner Luma
Roberto Nickson
transcript: You are not ready for what this new AI can do. They're Luma's new creative agents and let me just show you how powerful they are. So, let's say I want to create an ad for a luxury watch brand around the concept of borrowed time. Watch how amazing this is. The agents [music] orchestrate and perform multiple tasks for me. So, not only do I get a script and a shot list, I get voice-overs, contextual music and sound effects as well as a a brand identity, storyboard, [music] videos for each keyframe and a fully composed version. So, we get a comprehensive library of production assets created by multiple sub-agents running in parallel all from a simple text prompt. But, it actually goes even a step further. The agent in charge of review fixes any mistakes. So, for example, it found this image to have inconsistent dial indices, automatically flagged it and fixed it. And take a look. I mean, these sound effects and these visuals look and sound so damn good because different models have different specialties. The agents determine the best model to use depending on the task at hand. So, it's almost like having a full army of creative professionals working [music] 24/7 at your direction. And to me, that represents the future of creative production. I was completely blown away when I got early access to this. So, if you want to try it, comment Luma and I'll send you a link. I'll see you soon. Peace.
